	id = kar_releasables.1
	title = kar_releasables.1.t
	desc = kar_releasables.1.d

	fire_only_once = yes

	trigger = {
		NOT = { exists = KAE }
		is_year = 907
		NOT = { tag = KAE }
		OR = {
			owns = 128
		}
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 24
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_releasables.1.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 20 }
		release = KAE
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_releasables.1.b

			128 = { limit = { owned_by = ROOT } add_unrest = 5 }
	}
}
